claims.Finding: After FindEvent returns, this complete body writes context DWORD+56=0 before testing the signed result. For a result <=0, a nonnull context QWORD+96 causes DEC DWORD(target+1464) at 3E17E3, followed by setting mask0x2 in context+56. A prior release bit is not preserved or tested. For result >0 it tail-calls 41B320; the complete 41B320 body sets the execution entry and stack data, and has no explicit Actor+1464 increment or context+56 release-bit test. Thus the repeat resistance proved for 3E1A00/3E1410 does not extend to 3E1790 across this flag reset.
claims.Limitations: Local instruction semantics only. FindEvent and earlier/later callers may affect state. No valid reachable sequence that starts an already released context, double decrement, underflow, or gameplay bug is demonstrated. Arbitrary pointer aliasing is not excluded by this static study.

claims.Finding: On successful allocation, this body constructs a separate 112-byte context using source QWORD+0, +88 and +96 as constructor args2/3/4. It sets new-context+56 mask0x1, stores arg2 in DWORD+60, calls 41B320 with args3/4/5, and returns the new context. It does not locally append the context to a parent/global list. claims.Finding: This second allocation path also inherits source+96 as constructor arg4, giving each successfully constructed child its own Actor reference contribution. After setting child+56 mask0x1, child DWORD+60 and the execution entry, it appends the child to the parent's QWORD head+72/tail+80 list.
